title: Solution Architect Agent — Input
description: A business, analytics, data, or AI initiative request entering the Solution Architect intake. Only 'request_text' is required; everything else is optional context that, when provided, reduces the number of open questions.

request_id.description: Optional external identifier for tracking (ticket/initiative id).

request_text.description: The raw request, in the requester's own words. Can be a single sentence or a full brief.

business_context.description: Optional background: the business problem, driver, or opportunity behind the request.

known_systems.description: Systems, data sources, or platforms the requester already knows are involved.

known_constraints.description: Deadlines, budget, compliance, technology, or other constraints already known.

desired_outcome.description: What the requester says success looks like, if stated.

target_date.description: Optional requested delivery date or timeframe (free text or ISO date).

attachments.description: References to supporting material (links, doc names). Not the content itself.
